name: Circuit Toms
author: Lyle Mills
description: Two swept oscillators move from round electronic toms through dual-oscillator drums to ring-modulated zaps.

controls.label: Circuit
controls.description: Morphs one sine through a dual oscillator into a ring-modulated voice.

controls.label: Sweep
controls.description: Raises the attack pitch and lengthens its fall into the played note.

controls.label: Decay
controls.description: Extends the body from a short blip to a sustained electronic tom.

controls.label: Crack
controls.description: Adds a noisy attack and pushes the output circuit into soft saturation.

outputs.aux: The clean oscillators and attack transient.
